outcome: live birth rate per euploid embryo transfer
cohort: The cohort consisted of 228 patients with adenomyosis undergoing single euploid embryo transfer, matched 1:1 with controls without adenomyosis, who had transfers between 2016 and June 2023.
finding: Adenomyosis, especially focal adenomyosis, significantly reduced live birth rates after single euploid embryo transfer, but did not significantly affect perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: There was no statistically significant difference in childbirth delivery method (vaginal vs. cesarean section) between the adenomyosis and control groups.
